nora: quick update  ran a short canary for v4-int4 on long-doc route at 2% for 1.5h. p95 -85ms, cost -14%, long-doc MRR -1.4% (p=0.09). proposing a micro-capacitor: require 2 windows or shadow 24h. cc @ben @sam

ben: numbers sound close to threshold. suggest fallback rule: hard rollback only if (MRR_drop >=1.5% AND posterior_prob>0.9) OR hallucination_pp>=0.5. otherwise hold + shadow. also cap slice ramp to 4% for <1% traffic slices.

sam: add smoothing: require two consecutive 2h windows and rolling-median(w=3) on MRR. if slice-level anchor concordance drops >1% then convert to targeted shadow rather than global rollback.

canary-bot: smokecheck for 5467891234: long-doc MRR -1.4% (p=0.09), p95 -85ms, cost -14%. fallback NOT triggered. scheduled: 24h shadow for long-doc anchors at 2% and trace capture target 250k tokens. link: https://ci.redwood-inference/smoke/5467891234

nora: action items: (1) push micro-capacitor config with posterior check, (2) start 24h shadow @2% and collect traces, (3) add dashboard alert for slice MRR delta >=1% with 30m aggregation. will report back.

ben: add +/-10% jitter to promotion timing. nora: will do.
